capabilities: Slugify filenames of new notes created via the native New note hook
Store the original title in frontmatter title and aliases
Rename notes from a modal so frontmatter and slugified filename stay in sync
Re-slugify existing notes and folders from their titles
Configure the slug rule with a custom regex replace and live preview
extras: Manual installation only (copy main.js and manifest.json); no build step.
problem: Obsidian filenames typically mirror the note title with spaces and capitals, and there is no built-in way to keep files slug-clean while preserving a readable title.

relations.evidence: Pair it with the Front Matter Title plugin to display the original title

summary: Filename slugifier that renames new notes to kebab-case slugs while storing the human-readable title in frontmatter.
